cards.name: hero
cards.title: Repost on TikTok in **2 taps**
cards.sub: Share, then Repost. Your followers see it, and the original creator keeps the views and credit.

cards.name: versus
cards.title: A repost is **a share, not a copy**

good.label: Try
items: Post it to Reels and Shorts

bad.label: Avoid
items: Repost apps that want your login

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Use Repost for other people’s videos, and **your original file for your own.**
cards.by: The button keeps credit where it belongs. Re-upload apps don’t.
